Clarity Capsules for focus

Benefits of Clarity Capsules. The clarity capsules are designed to assist human beings to obtain higher mind performance. High excellent elements boom the float of oxygen and vitamins for your mind, making you sense extra energized and targeted so that you can carry out at your best.

Effects & Benefits of Clarity Capsules.

Developed to enhance many elements of mind fitness and overall performance together with quicker response time, elevated alertness, more advantageous memory, advanced cognition, and intellectual flexibility.

Buy Microdosing Clarity Capsules.

Ingredients:

Psilocybin – 50mg/200mg, Lion’s Mane – 100mg, Bacopa – 45mg, Pine Bark – 45mg, Choline – 30mg, Vinpocetine – 10mg, Huperzine A 1% – 15mg

Clarity contains natural antioxidants that protect your brain cells and enhances neurogenesis (the growth of new brain cells).

Ingested 50mg to 250mg

“The average psilocybin microdose can range from 25mg to 250mg. We recommend starting at a low dose of 50mg, or 25mg if you are sensitive to substances. Dosing schedules can vary as it depends on individual preference.

Popular dosing schedules include:

• 1 dose every 2 to 3 days

• 1 dose per day for 4 days followed by a 3 day break

• 1 dose per day for 2 days followed by a 2 day break

Microdosing effects

• Increased cognitive skills

• Improved awareness of both surroundings and self

• Improved understanding and communication of one’s emotions.
